newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close lower as CANTV offering opens.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close lower as CANTV offering opens.

text.p: Caracas stocks ended lower Tuesday as investors closed positions to raise cash as the CANTV telephone company began its massive public share offering, traders said.
"Everyone only has eyes for CANTV.... We'll see the market like this for the rest of the week," said Cavelba broker Johann Gomez.
The bolsa's leading share .IBC index slipped 2.14 percent to close at 5,786.21 points, as 31 stocks fell, two rose and four closed unchanged, according to preliminary figures from the exchange.
